C2.worst_defect: 'Before you start' on home repeats the refund and coupon caveats the comparison table above has just stated, so the caveats read twice.

C3.worst_defect: Quick start never shows the finish line. 'Check it worked' is a text-only list, with no screenshot of the till sign-in screen or of the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard.

C4.worst_defect: Limitations is 12 loosely spaced bullets of equal weight, with no grouping (sync / payments / hardware) and no emphasis. The overview ends with three 'Next steps' cards and then a separate full-width 'Quick start ›' pager card that points to the same page.

C5.worst_defect: The home hero till screenshot is cut mid-row. A sliver of a fourth row of product tiles shows under 'Filter Coffee' to 'Leather Keyring', and the 'Guest · 3 items' strip is clipped. C6.worst_defect: The phone hero screenshot truncates the cart header to 'Q...'. The chip 'packages/vendure-plugin/CHANGELOG.md' breaks mid-token into two chip fragments. The sticky TOC bar already reads '1. Install the plugin' while the reader is still at the page title.

C7.worst_defect: The OG card crops the till screenshot through the product tiles, cutting off the 'In Stock' pills and the 'Add charge' button. Otherwise clean: Lighthouse 98/100/100/100, a real 404, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD.

overall_worst.defect: The hero till screenshot, the first thing a visitor sees, ends mid-row with slivers of a fourth row of product tiles and a clipped 'Guest · 3 items' strip, so it reads as an accidental crop rather than a composed product shot.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.01 (and the same crop in og-image.png)
overall_worst.fix: Crop or mask the hero screenshot on a row boundary: end cleanly after the third tile row with a soft fade or a frame edge, or recapture at a viewport height that ends between rows. Then regenerate the OG image from the same clean crop.
